_comment: Smithing rework (Nate, 9 Oct; ~/claude-nate-release/specs/smithing-rework-1009.md): the Blacksmith's 7 craft tiers and the families each one opens, read by smithing.js and manuals.js. id is the family key of loot-materials.json (an item's family comes from there). A family above T1 needs its technique (a manual, private.dboManuals). book: 'staff' = never shop or loot (given in roleplay); 'apprentice' = no book, learned only by apprenticeship (supervisorRace). where: the learnHint shown in the F3 Blacksmith tab. Book records come from the PC as config smithing.books { <id>: '<hex>:<plugin>' }. Spec families with no loot-materials family yet (Bronze, Glacial Crystal, Amber, Madness) are left out until loot_materials.py classifies them.
